records.subject: Re: Password reset
records.body:
Hi Hana,

Thanks for your patience on this. An admin can resend an invite, or remove and re-invite, a teammate who lost access to their email -- that's usually the fastest path.

Thanks so much,
Tariq Diallo

records.subject: Getting started with Wrenfield
records.body:
Hi Hana,

Thanks for signing up for Wrenfield. Two things that help teams get going: create a project, and invite at least one teammate from Account Settings -> Members.

Happy to answer anything.

Thanks,
Chidi Haddad

decisions.rationale: 6 days in, no project or key milestone despite three outreach emails (email:2c0e80b7, email:c839a16c, email:c1a9ad8d) and zero customer replies or tickets. One invite sent shows some intent, and Pro plan suggests real commitment, but silence plus no first project with 8 days left makes unaided activation unlikely.

draft.subject: One next step in Wrenfield
draft.body:
Hi Hana,

You've already got a teammate invited, which is a good start. The next step that usually makes Wrenfield click is a first project \u2014 projects are the main organizing unit, and tasks live inside them. The in-app onboarding flow walks through creating a first project if you'd rather do it yourself.

Would a short call this week help? I can walk through setting up your first project with you and answer anything that comes up.

Best,
Chidi
